description: The live scene tree of a running game, including nodes created at runtime. Returns: nested nodes with name, type (script class_name or path when scripted), path, object_id and visibility. Use the path or object_id with runtime_inspect.

max_depth.description: Levels below the start to include (default 8)

session_id.description: Session from runtime_run. Required only when several games run.

name: runtime_tree
